 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 5 10-02-2025 No one appears on behalf of the appellant.

2. The present application has been preferred:
against the impugned judgment dated 02.08.2024 passed by the Learned 1 Additional District and Sessions Judge, Patna by which the appellant was found guilty for the offence under Section 376(1) of the LP.C. and the sentence dated 09.08.2024 passed by the Learned 1st Additional District and Sessions Judge, Patna by which the sentence was awarded to the appellant for rigorous imprisonment of 10 years under Section 376(1) LP.C. and fine of Rs. 10,000/- and in default of payment of fine
the further sentence was awarded for four months and the period Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.4474 of 2024(5) dt.10-02-2025 undergone during trial

will be Set-Off by the court of the Learned Additional Sessions Judge- I, Patna in connection with Sessions Trial No.- 936/2019, C.I.S. No.- 936 of 2019, Arising out of Mahila P.S.Case No.- 39 of 2019 for the offence under Section 376(1) I.P.C. passed by the court of the Learned 1 Additional District and Sessions Judge, Patna.

3. The appellant was allowed to appear in the examination pursuant to advertisement no. 22/2024 between 30.01.2025 to 01.02.2025 and was to surrender on 02.02.2025 and the surrender Prashant Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93013347/
